failed_gates: same-timing KODEX 200 annualised excess return >= 2.0 percentage points
same-timing KODEX 200 rolling 12-month beat rate >= 60 percent
double-cost rolling 12-month beat rate >= 60 percent against both benchmarks
diagnosis: The risk-state timing, not the four-stock selection sleeve, produced the market outperformance.
Replacing 55 percent of KODEX 200 with four stocks slightly reduced CAGR and increased maximum drawdown against the same-timing benchmark.
The stock sleeve raised executed orders from 7 to 47 and did not earn back its added implementation cost.
The selection sleeve lagged the same-timing benchmark in 2019 and 2020; its 2021 gain was not broad or persistent enough.
decision: Reject v1 without opening 2023-2024 or 2025-2026 candidate data. Preserve the frozen low-turnover risk state and test a separately pre-registered, low-turnover ETF risk-budget candidate instead of another concentrated stock-ranking revision.
